clinical_records_finalized_ck.name: clinical_records_finalized_ck
clinical_records_finalized_ck.value: ("clinical_records"."status" = 'finalized') = ("clinical_records"."finalized_at" is not null and "clinical_records"."content_hash" is not null)

odontogram_tooth_ck.name: odontogram_tooth_ck
odontogram_tooth_ck.value: ("odontogram_entries"."tooth" between 11 and 18) or ("odontogram_entries"."tooth" between 21 and 28) or ("odontogram_entries"."tooth" between 31 and 38) or ("odontogram_entries"."tooth" between 41 and 48) or ("odontogram_entries"."tooth" between 51 and 55) or ("odontogram_entries"."tooth" between 61 and 65) or ("odontogram_entries"."tooth" between 71 and 75) or ("odontogram_entries"."tooth" between 81 and 85)

payment_allocations_sign_ck.name: payment_allocations_sign_ck
payment_allocations_sign_ck.value: ("payment_allocations"."refund_id" is null and "payment_allocations"."amount" > 0) or ("payment_allocations"."refund_id" is not null and "payment_allocations"."amount" < 0)
